body.message:
We would like to inform you that you may collect the payment in cash. However, as the booking is under Mr. Ahmad Khezr Gouraki’s name, if Mrs. Shaghayegh Sadeghi will be collecting the payment on his behalf, we kindly require a written email confirmation from Mr. Ahmad authorizing her to collect the payment.

If Mr. Ahmad will be coming personally to collect the payment, no email authorization will be required.

Thank you for your cooperation and understanding.
